name: ticker_price_source_filter_lq1695_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: LQ-20261107-1695 — the reader half of the operator price rule (2026-11-07: Finviz cache
fresh <=30 min, else a fresh Schwab/Alpaca/moomoo quote, else the stored mark flagged stale;
never yfinance). LQ-1679 removed the last yfinance WRITERS; the store still held 687,708 yfinance
rows (newest 2026-10-30, measured read-only 2026-11-09) and source-blind readers served them as
current closes — sector_momentum_engine._closes and price_db_sync._prior_close among 31 sites in
25 files, now filtered through the one shared predicate lib/price_provenance.sql_source_allowed.
This gate pins (A) a SHRINK-ONLY repo scan: every SQL statement under scripts/ naming
ticker_prices carries the predicate or is listed in config/ticker_price_reader_baseline.json
with a kind and a checkable reason, so a new source-blind reader fails and a stale baseline
entry fails; and (B) behaviour on synthetic rows in SQLite, with a negative control proving the
exclusion is the predicate's and not the fixture's. No DB, no network, no credential, no
destructive statement: SELECT-only SQL in an in-memory table.
